example.en: The military commanders decided to deploy peacekeepers along the border.

example.en: Air pollution produces highly damaging effects on children's health.

example.tj: Ифлосшавии ҳаво ба саломатии кӯдакон таъсири хеле зараровар мерасонад.

example.en: Regular vehicle maintenance ensures long-term safety and high performance.
